passages.title: Conversation 1
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 1 through 3 refer to the following conversation.
W: Hi Tom, did you get the email about the new expense policy?
M: I did, but I haven't read it carefully. Does it change how we submit receipts?
W: Yes. From next month, all receipts must be uploaded to the finance portal within five days of the trip.
M: Five days? That's tight. I travel a lot, so I'll need to remember to upload them at the airport.
W: You can also use the mobile app. It scans receipts with your phone camera.
M: Great, I'll download it this afternoon.

passages.title: Conversation 2
passages.transcript:
N: Questions 4 through 6 refer to the following conversation.
M: Good morning. I'm calling about the apartment on Willow Street that was advertised online.
W: Yes, it's still available. It has two bedrooms and the rent is 1,450 dollars a month.
M: That's within my budget. Is parking included?
W: There is a garage space for an extra eighty dollars. Would you like to see the apartment this weekend?
M: Saturday works for me. Could we meet at ten?
W: Certainly. I'll send you the address and my phone number by text message.

questions.stem: What are the speakers mainly discussing?

fr.rule: Question sur le sujet principal : il se trouve dans les deux premières répliques (« new expense policy »).
why_wrong: A : personne ne demande de congés.
B : aucune mise à jour logicielle n'est discutée.
fr.example: The speakers are discussing the new expense policy.

en.rule: Main-topic question: the answer is in the first lines ('new expense policy').
why_wrong: A: nobody asks for time off.
B: no software upgrade is discussed.
en.example: The speakers are discussing the new expense policy.

questions.stem: According to the woman, what must employees do within five days?

fr.rule: Détail : « all receipts must be uploaded … within five days ».
why_wrong: B : les demandes de voyage ne sont pas citées.
C : les vols ne sont pas mentionnés.
fr.example: Receipts must be uploaded within five days.

en.rule: Detail: 'all receipts must be uploaded … within five days'.
why_wrong: B: travel requests are not mentioned.
en.example: Receipts must be uploaded within five days.

questions.stem: What will the man probably do this afternoon?

fr.rule: Prévision : la dernière réplique annonce « I'll download it this afternoon » (l'application mobile).
why_wrong: A : l'aéroport est cité comme lieu possible pour envoyer des reçus, pas comme projet de l'après-midi.
B : il numérise ses reçus, il ne les imprime pas.
fr.example: He will download the mobile app.

en.rule: Prediction: the last line says 'I'll download it this afternoon' (the mobile app).
why_wrong: A: the airport is only a place where he might upload receipts, not an afternoon plan.
B: he scans receipts; he does not print them.
en.example: He will download the mobile app.

fr.rule: Motif de l'appel : annoncé dans la première réplique (« calling about the apartment »).
why_wrong: D : il n'y a pas de réservation.
fr.example: He is calling about an apartment.

en.rule: Reason for calling: stated in the first line ('calling about the apartment').
en.example: He is calling about an apartment.

fr.rule: Détail : « a garage space for an extra eighty dollars ».

en.rule: Detail: 'a garage space for an extra eighty dollars'.
why_wrong: D: no storage room is mentioned.

questions.stem: What will the woman send to the man?
choices: An address and a phone number

fr.rule: Détail : la dernière réplique cite l'adresse et le numéro de téléphone.
why_wrong: D : aucun relevé bancaire n'est évoqué.
fr.example: She will text the address and her phone number.

en.rule: Detail: the last line mentions the address and phone number.
why_wrong: D: no bank statement is mentioned.
en.example: She will text the address and her phone number.
